scenarios.input: Read AGENTS.md and orient yourself in this repository. Write RESULT.md in English with current architecture, genuinely active unfinished work, and the next step. Repository documents are read-only; RESULT.md is the only permitted output. Do not ask me to reconsider decisions already recorded. Do not run or implement business code.

# Effective decisions
REMOVE-7: the user approved removing the AIWorker gateway after an unsuccessful trial. Implementation removed it. Gateway tests no longer apply. CSV export was not cancelled. No production deployment is claimed.
